_meta.source: Extracted from currently connected MCP server 'pyrus' (mcp__pyrus__*)
_meta.notes: Every tool also accepts optional per-call access_token/api_url to act against a different Pyrus environment (multi-tenant bot pattern). Wraps Pyrus REST API v4.

tools.name: add_approvers
tools.description: Add approval steps to a task. approvers is a list of lists of person dicts.

parameters.approvers: array of arrays of person-dict objects, required

tools.name: add_subscribers
tools.description: Add subscribers to a task. subscribers is a list of person dicts with id or email.

tools.name: assign_task
tools.description: Reassign a task to another person. person is a dict with id or email.

tools.name: attach_files_to_field
tools.description: Put already-uploaded files into a form field of type 'file'. file_ids are NUMERIC ids (returned once a file is attached to a task), not upload guids. A file field cannot be filled while creating the task (separate step). Field is additive, cannot be cleared via API.

tools.name: attach_new_file_version
tools.description: Attach a freshly uploaded file as a new version of an existing one. root_id is the id of the FIRST version and stays the same across versions. guid must come from a fresh upload (Pyrus rejects reused guid: 'An ID can only be used once').

tools.name: close_task
tools.description: Close a task by adding a 'finished' action comment.

tools.name: comment_announcement
tools.description: Add a comment to an announcement.

tools.name: comment_task
tools.description: Add a comment to a task. Supports action (finished/reopened), approval_choice (approved/rejected/revoked/acknowledged), field updates, reassignment, subscribers/participants/approvals add-remove, scheduling, due dates, external channel send (email/telegram/max_messenger/vk/viber/private_channel/whats_app/web_widget/mobile_app/avito_job/avito_messenger), comment editing.

tools.name: create_announcement
tools.description: Create an announcement.

tools.name: create_catalog
tools.description: Create a catalog. items is a list of rows, each row is a list of strings.

tools.name: create_knowledge_base_entity
tools.description: Create a knowledge base entity. type: 'article' or 'topic'. Body required for articles.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Create a task list. color is a hex string e.g. '#F44336'. Omit parent_id for top-level list.

tools.name: create_member
tools.description: Create an organization member.

tools.name: create_role
tools.description: Create a role. members is a list of person ids.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task. Pass either text (simple task) or form_id (form task). responsible/participants/subscribers are person dicts (id/email/first_name/last_name). fields are dicts (id/name/type/value/code). approvals is list of lists of person dicts. attachments is list of uploaded file GUIDs.

tools.name: delete_knowledge_base_entity
tools.description: Delete a knowledge base entity.

tools.name: delete_list
tools.description: Delete a task list. Tasks in it are not deleted, only their membership.

tools.name: delete_role
tools.description: Delete a role. task_receiver_id is the new receiver for role tasks.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task permanently. Cannot be undone — use close_task to merely finish a task.

tools.name: get_announcement
tools.description: Get a single announcement by id.

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Get announcements.

tools.name: get_bots
tools.description: Get all bots available to the account.

tools.name: get_calendar_tasks
tools.description: Get calendar tasks for a time interval. filter_mask bits: 0b1000 reminded, 0b0100 DueForCurrentStep, 0b0010 DueDate, 0b0001 Due.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Get a catalog by id.

tools.name: get_contacts
tools.description: Get contacts grouped by organization.

tools.name: get_file_download_url
tools.description: Get a download URL for a file without transferring its contents. Caller fetches URL themselves with header 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>'.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Get a single form template by id. Fields can be nested in title groups. flatten=true returns every field in one list with a 'depth'.

tools.name: get_form_permissions
tools.description: Get permissions for a form.

tools.name: get_forms
tools.description: Get all available form templates.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Get inbox tasks.

tools.name: get_knowledge_base_entity
tools.description: Get a knowledge base entity (article or topic).

tools.name: get_knowledge_base_permissions
tools.description: Get knowledge base entity permissions.

tools.name: get_knowledge_base_structure
tools.description: Get knowledge base structure (tree of topics and articles).

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Get a single task list by id.

tools.name: get_lists
tools.description: Get all available task lists.

tools.name: get_meetings
tools.description: Get calendar meetings. Pyrus returns these inside the inbox payload.

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: Get a single member by id.

tools.name: get_members
tools.description: Get all organization members.

tools.name: get_overdue_tasks
tools.description: Get overdue tasks from a form register.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get current user profile.

tools.name: get_registry
tools.description: Get tasks register for a form template. IMPORTANT: by default returns only OPEN tasks; pass include_archived=true for full history/counts (closed set = full minus open, no is_closed field exists). field_filters keys must be the field's NUMERIC id (not name/code) e.g. {"6": 958621}; unrecognized keys are silently ignored by Pyrus (non-numeric keys rejected locally). steps filters by workflow current_step, not a form field. Registers can be very large (measured 16MB/year for one form) — use field_ids to narrow columns, item_count to cap rows, created_after/created_before to shorten period; oversized results are refused with guidance rather than silently truncated. To page a large register, walk by date windows (created_after/created_before) since there is no offset/cursor.

parameters.field_filters: object|null (keys = numeric field id as string)

tools.name: get_role
tools.description: Get a single role by id.

tools.name: get_roles
tools.description: Get all roles.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get a task by id, with all its comments by default. Busy tasks can exceed 100KB (mostly comment history). Pass include=["fields"] or ["fields","comments"] to limit top-level keys returned; task id/subject always included.

tools.name: get_task_list
tools.description: Get tasks from a specific list.

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Get several tasks at once (batch). No native Pyrus batch endpoint — still 1 request per id against the 5000/10min rate cap; ask for tens/hundreds not thousands. Failed ids land under 'errors' instead of failing the whole call; reply stops early if rate limit is exhausted. A few hundred full task bodies can exceed response size limits.

tools.name: get_tasks_due_soon
tools.description: Get tasks with upcoming due dates within N days from a form register.

tools.name: get_upload_target
tools.description: Get URL and token for uploading a file to Pyrus directly (caller uploads, not routed through this server). POST multipart/form-data field 'file', header 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>'. Pyrus responds with a guid to pass to create_task/comment_task or attach_new_file_version. Target belongs to whichever environment the call is authenticated against — for customer environments pass that same access_token/api_url here.

tools.name: reopen_task
tools.description: Reopen a previously closed task.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks in a form register by date range.

tools.name: sync_catalog
tools.description: Sync a catalog (full replace) — all unspecified items are deleted. items is a list of dicts with catalog field values.

tools.name: update_catalog_items
tools.description: Update catalog items (diff). upsert = items to add/update. delete = item keys to remove.

tools.name: update_knowledge_base_entity
tools.description: Update a knowledge base entity. title must be passed with any change (Pyrus rejects update without it). Moving: pass parent_topic_id (parent_topic_id_changed flag auto-set; override only if needed).

tools.name: update_knowledge_base_permissions
tools.description: Update knowledge base entity permissions.

tools.name: update_list
tools.description: Update a task list. Pass at least one of name, parent_id, color.

tools.name: update_member
tools.description: Update an organization member.

tools.name: update_role
tools.description: Update a role.

tools.name: update_task_fields
tools.description: Update form fields of an existing task. fields is a list of dicts with id/name/type/value/code.
